mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer c WHERE ) customerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity o JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE AND o.stage_code NOT IN ('WON','LOST','CLOSED')) openOpportunities, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(k.performance_amount),0) FROM crm_contract k WHERE ) signedAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.received_amount),0) FROM crm_payment_record r WHERE ) receivedAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(k.outstanding_amount),0) FROM crm_contract k JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=k.customer_id WHERE AND k.contract_status IN ('SIGNED','PERFORMING','SETTLED') ) outstandingAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(k.contract_amount),0) FROM crm_contract k JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=k.customer_id WHERE AND k.contract_status IN ('SIGNED','PERFORMING','SETTLED')) currentContractAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(k.received_amount),0) FROM crm_contract k JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=k.customer_id WHERE AND k.contract_status IN ('SIGNED','PERFORMING','SETTLED')) currentReceivedAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(pp.planned_amount-pp.received_amount,0)),0) FROM crm_payment_period pp JOIN crm_payment_plan p ON p.id=pp.plan_id JOIN crm_contract k ON k.id=p.contract_id JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=k.customer_id WHERE AND k.contract_status IN ('SIGNED','PERFORMING') AND p.is_current=1 AND p.approval_status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED') AND pp.replaced_by_plan_id IS NULL AND pp.due_date < #{today}) overdueAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_contract k WHERE AND k.performance_legacy=1) legacyContracts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_payment_record r WHERE AND r.performance_legacy=1) legacyReceipts

SELECT o.stage_code code,COUNT(*) count,COALESCE(SUM(o.expected_amount),0) amount FROM crm_opportunity o JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE AND o.created_at >= #{start} AND o.created_at < #{end} GROUP BY o.stage_code

SELECT month,SUM(signedAmount) signedAmount,SUM(receivedAmount) receivedAmount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(k.performance_confirmed_at,'%Y-%m') month,SUM(k.performance_amount) signedAmount,0 receivedAmount FROM crm_contract k WHERE GROUP BY month UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.received_at,'%Y-%m') month,0 signedAmount,SUM(r.received_amount) receivedAmount FROM crm_payment_record r WHERE GROUP BY month ) t GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT todo_type type,COUNT(*) count FROM crm_todo WHERE recipient_id=#{actor} AND todo_status='PENDING' GROUP BY todo_type ORDER BY todo_type
